mentions.name: miniRec
mentions.description: Windows tray app that records system audio plus microphone to mp3/wav. It needs no special driver, installs without admin rights, stays light on resources, is invisible to third parties such as video meeting participants, and auto-stops after a configurable period of silence (default 5 minutes).
mentions.problem: Existing utilities like Voicemeter, AudioRouter, or DAWs cover this, but this version is simpler and lighter for recording system audio plus microphone.
mentions.source_excerpt:
- miniRec: records system audio + microphone to mp3/wav

Alternatives: various utilities like Voicemeter, AudioRouter, or some DAWs

Features: does not require any special driver; installs without admin rights; light on resources; "invisible" to third parties (video meetings); auto turn off after 5 minutes of silence (configurable)
